parts.zh: 白肉，如鸡肉，可能会像红肉一样升高血液胆固醇水平
在这项研究中,研究人员观察了113名健康人
结果显示，白肉和红肉饮食对血液胆固醇水平有相同的影响
该团队承认，尽管有他们的研究结果
W: 对,没错。会很随意的
M: 太好了!那您可以买几种不同类型的奶酪
W: 不想花太多。就算30美元吧
M: 我建议至少买一种软奶酪和一种硬奶酪
W: 听起来不错。软奶酪和硬奶酪有什么区别呢?
W: 好的,很棒。那硬奶酪呢?

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the study?

choices.text: It examines the effect of cholesterol on people's health.
choices.zh: 它检验了胆固醇对人们健康的影响。

choices.text: Its participants all had high blood cholesterol levels.
choices.zh: 它的参与者都有高血胆固醇水平。

choices.text: It questions the benefits of a vegetarian protein diet.
choices.zh: 它质疑素食蛋白饮食的益处。

choices.text: Its finding came as a surprise to the researchers.
choices.zh: 它的发现让研究人员感到意外。

items.stem: What did the researchers acknowledge?

choices.text: They do not know all the effects of eating meat.
choices.zh: 他们不知道吃肉的所有影响。

choices.text: Red meat itself does not cause heart diseases.
choices.zh: 红肉本身不会导致心脏病。

choices.text: White meat may be healthier than red meat.
choices.zh: 白肉可能比红肉更健康。

choices.text: Vegetarian protein may be easier to absorb.
choices.zh: 素食蛋白可能更容易被吸收。

items.stem: What does the news report say about the accident at the crossing of High Street in Milton?

choices.text: It may have been due to the lorry driver's drunk driving.
choices.zh: 这可能是由于卡车司机酒后驾驶造成的。

choices.text: It may affect the local supply of turkeys for Christmas.
choices.zh: 这可能影响当地圣诞节火鸡的供应。

choices.text: It interrupted traffic for several hours running.
choices.zh: 这使交通连续中断了几个小时。

choices.text: It was caused by a lorry running into a trailer.
choices.zh: 这是由一辆卡车撞上拖车引起的。

items.stem: What do we learn about the crossing on High Street?

choices.text: It has been the scene of several fatal accidents recently.
choices.zh: 这里最近发生过几起致命事故。

choices.text: It is the spot that causes the local police a lot of worry.
choices.zh: 这是让当地警方十分担忧的地点。

choices.text: It has witnessed several traffic accidents this year.
choices.zh: 这里今年发生过几起交通事故。

choices.text: It is a location frequented by local traffic police.
choices.zh: 这是当地交警经常出现的地点。

items.stem: What is Bangalore airport trying to do about the helicopter taxi service?

choices.text: Get approval to add more routes.
choices.zh: 获得批准增加更多航线。

choices.text: Attract more international tourists.
choices.zh: 吸引更多国际游客。

choices.text: Advertise it through a mobile app.
choices.zh: 通过移动应用程序进行宣传。

choices.text: Make it affordable to common folk.
choices.zh: 使普通民众能负担得起。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the helicopter taxi ride?

choices.text: It costs more than twice as much as a car ride.
choices.zh: 它的费用是汽车车费的两倍多。

choices.text: It is gaining popularity among ordinary Indians.
choices.zh: 它在普通印度人中越来越受欢迎。

choices.text: It symbolizes India's advancement in high-tech.
choices.zh: 它象征着印度在高科技领域的进步。

choices.text: It can get anywhere in the city within 15 minutes.
choices.zh: 它可以在15分钟内到达城市的任何地方。

items.stem: Who are the targeted customers of the helicopter taxi service?

choices.text: International tourists.
choices.zh: 国际游客。

choices.text: High-class travelers.
choices.zh: 高端旅客。

choices.text: Prominent superstars.
choices.zh: 知名超级明星。

choices.text: Customers in a hurry.
choices.zh: 赶时间的顾客。

items.stem: What does the woman plan to do for the weekend?

choices.text: Treat her friends in a bar.
choices.zh: 在酒吧请她的朋友们。

choices.text: Take a trip to Washington.
choices.zh: 去华盛顿旅行。

choices.text: Make some cheese.
choices.zh: 做一些奶酪。

choices.text: Throw a party.
choices.zh: 举办一个聚会。

items.stem: What does the man suggest the woman do?

choices.text: Spend no more than 30 dollars.
choices.zh: 花费不超过30美元。

choices.text: Buy different kinds of cheese.
choices.zh: 购买不同种类的奶酪。

choices.text: Help him prepare the barbecue.
choices.zh: 帮他准备烧烤。

choices.text: Find out different people's tastes.
choices.zh: 了解不同人的口味。

items.stem: What does the man say about Spanish goat cheese?

choices.text: It is the best kind of hard cheese.
choices.zh: 它是最好的硬质奶酪。

choices.text: It is the most popular in Spain.
choices.zh: 它在西班牙最受欢迎。

choices.text: It is more delicious than honey.
choices.zh: 它比蜂蜜更美味。

choices.text: It is a good choice for children.
choices.zh: 它对儿童来说是个好选择。

items.stem: What is the woman going to do at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: Buy what the man recommended.
choices.zh: 购买男士推荐的奶酪。

choices.text: Have a taste of both of the cheeses.
choices.zh: 品尝这两种奶酪。

choices.text: Choose one of the two types of cheese.
choices.zh: 在两种奶酪中选择一种。

choices.text: Ask the man to cut the cheese into slices.
choices.zh: 让男士把奶酪切成片。

items.stem: What does the woman say about using e-textbooks?

choices.text: New teachers and staff have to be recruited.
choices.zh: 需要招聘新的教师和工作人员。

choices.text: It might take some time for students to adapt.
choices.zh: 学生可能需要一些时间来适应。

choices.text: It involves buying lots of tablets and software.
choices.zh: 这涉及购买大量平板电脑和软件。

choices.text: The software has to be constantly upgraded.
choices.zh: 软件必须不断升级。

items.stem: According to the man, how can the use of tablets benefit students?

choices.text: It can greatly improve their learning efficiency.
choices.zh: 它可以大大提高他们的学习效率。

choices.text: It can help them to interact more with teachers.
choices.zh: 它可以帮助他们与教师进行更多互动。

choices.text: It can save their trouble of carrying printed books.
choices.zh: 它可以省去他们携带纸质书籍的麻烦。

choices.text: It can develop their skills in using electronic devices.
choices.zh: 它可以培养他们使用电子设备的技能。

items.stem: What does the woman say about students using tablets?

choices.text: They may have trouble comprehending texts.
choices.zh: 他们可能在理解文本方面遇到困难。

choices.text: They may encounter technological problems.
choices.zh: 他们可能会遇到技术问题。

choices.text: They may pay less respect to teachers.
choices.zh: 他们可能对教师较少尊重。

choices.text: They may get distracted more easily.
choices.zh: 他们可能更容易分心。

items.stem: What does the woman say about making electronic readers?

choices.text: It generates a great deal of electronic garbage.
choices.zh: 它产生大量电子垃圾。

choices.text: It does a lot of damage to the environment.
choices.zh: 它对环境造成很大破坏。

choices.text: It emits huge amounts of harmful radiation.
choices.zh: 它排放大量有害辐射。

choices.text: It accelerates the exhaustion of rare minerals.
choices.zh: 它加速稀有矿物的枯竭。

items.stem: What does the passage say we tend to do every day?

choices.text: Communicate with our coworkers.
choices.zh: 与同事交流。

choices.text: Encounter people in different places.
choices.zh: 在不同地方遇见人。

choices.text: Judge people based on our first impressions.
choices.zh: 根据第一印象判断他人。

choices.text: Engage in a variety of psychological activities.
choices.zh: 从事各种心理活动。

items.stem: What do we learn about person perception from this passage?

choices.text: It is an objective evaluation of a person's character.
choices.zh: 它是对一个人性格的客观评价。

choices.text: It is a mental process influenced by many factors.
choices.zh: 它是一个受许多因素影响的心理过程。

choices.text: It contributes to the formation of personal traits.
choices.zh: 它有助于个人特质的形成。

choices.text: It varies greatly among different social groups.
choices.zh: 它在不同社会群体中差异很大。

items.stem: What is the problem with using social categorization in person perception?

choices.text: It can lead to incorrect judgments.
choices.zh: 它可能导致错误的判断。

choices.text: It can cause mistrust among people.
choices.zh: 它可能引起人与人之间的不信任。

choices.text: It can result in instant losses.
choices.zh: 它可能造成即时损失。

choices.text: It can give rise to gender bias.
choices.zh: 它可能引发性别偏见。

items.stem: What does the new study suggest about young people today and those from the previous generation?

choices.text: Both groups spend a lot of time on mobile devices.
choices.zh: 两个群体都在移动设备上花费大量时间。

choices.text: Both groups attach importance to social connections.
choices.zh: 两个群体都重视社会联系。

choices.text: They are equally competent in using new technology.
choices.zh: 他们在使用新技术方面同样有能力。

choices.text: They are similar in terms of social skills.
choices.zh: 他们在社交技能方面相似。

items.stem: What did the study find about children who accessed social networking sites many times a day?

choices.text: Their social skills were negatively affected.
choices.zh: 他们的社交技能受到了负面影响。

choices.text: Their school performance was slightly lower.
choices.zh: 他们的学业表现略有下降。

choices.text: Their emotions were much harder to regulate.
choices.zh: 他们的情绪更加难以调节。

choices.text: Their relations with peers were badly strained.
choices.zh: 他们与同龄人的关系严重紧张。

items.stem: What is adults' worry about technological change?

choices.text: It may pose a threat to their children's safety.
choices.zh: 它可能对他们孩子的安全构成威胁。

choices.text: It may affect society's traditional values.
choices.zh: 它可能影响社会的传统价值观。

choices.text: It may hurt their relations with children.
choices.zh: 它可能损害他们与孩子的关系。

choices.text: It may change their children's ethical values.
choices.zh: 它可能改变他们孩子的伦理价值观。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about inspiration from consuming others' ideas and success stories?

choices.text: It is motivating.
choices.zh: 它具有激励作用。

choices.text: It is passive.
choices.zh: 它是被动的。

choices.text: It is incredible.
choices.zh: 它令人难以置信。

choices.text: It is impracticable.
choices.zh: 它不切实际。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about active inspiration?

choices.text: It results in short-term excitement.
choices.zh: 它会产生短期的兴奋感。

choices.text: It helps us avoid making mistakes.
choices.zh: 它帮助我们避免犯错。

choices.text: It breeds long-term passion and enthusiasm.
choices.zh: 它孕育长期的热情和热忱。

choices.text: It is bound to help us achieve greater success.
choices.zh: 它必定会帮助我们取得更大的成功。

items.stem: What does the passage say passive inspiration can do?

choices.text: Drive us forward.
choices.zh: 推动我们前进。

choices.text: Bring us power.
choices.zh: 给我们带来力量。

choices.text: Spur us to action.
choices.zh: 激励我们采取行动。

choices.text: Give us ideas.
choices.zh: 给我们提供想法。

items.stem: Where does the best inspiration come from according to the passage?

choices.text: Listening to success stories.
choices.zh: 倾听成功故事。

choices.text: Applying ideas to one's life.
choices.zh: 将想法应用到自己的生活中。

choices.text: Following the advice of experts.
choices.zh: 遵循专家的建议。

choices.text: Consuming the world around us.
choices.zh: 接纳我们周围的世界。
